naming: tool name = command name with '.' replaced by '_'

tools.description: Set a clip's fades, volume (dB) or pan
tools.name: audio_set

tools.description: Split a clip (and its linked partners) at a timeline time
tools.name: clip_split

tools.description: Trim the start or end edge of a clip (linked partners follow; the main track closes up)
tools.name: clip_trim

tools.description: Undo your last change, or another actor's (`actor`; `*` = anyone's latest)
tools.name: edit_undo

tools.description: Export a sequence to an MP4 file (H.264 + AAC) as a background job; returns job_id
tools.name: export_start

tools.description: Delete items and their linked partners (the main track closes up)
tools.name: item_delete

tools.description: Move items in time and/or to another track (linked partners follow)
tools.name: item_move

tools.description: Set an item's name, enabled, opacity, audio, transform, crop, flip or blend mode (partial)
tools.name: item_set_props

tools.description: Get a background job's state, progress and error (analysis, export)
tools.name: job_status

tools.description: Wait up to timeout_ms (max 60 s) for a background job to finish; returns its state
tools.name: job_wait

tools.description: Add or replace keys on one property of an item
tools.name: keyframe_set

tools.description: Import media files: probe and register them now, return media ids and analysis job ids
tools.name: media_import

tools.description: List the project's media (filter, sort, paged; default by id)
tools.name: media_list

tools.description: Get project name, default format and a summary of its sequences
tools.name: project_info

tools.description: Open a project folder or .cutweave file (closes the current project)
tools.name: project_open

tools.description: Get a sequence: summary (depth 0), tracks (1) or tracks with items (2)
tools.name: timeline_get

tools.description: Insert a media clip at a time on a track (adds linked audio for video with sound)
tools.name: timeline_insert
